subject: EDEE
title: Language Arts
description: Different approaches to language arts education in the contexts of kindergarten and elementary classrooms will be investigated. Explores current research and theories related to language and literacy development, learning and teaching. Opportunities for cultivating techniques for aligning language arts pedagogy, curriculum, instruction and assessment will be provided.

corequisites.text: EDEE 253 or EDEE 254, and EDEE 283 or EDEE 284.

notes: **Due to the intensive nature of this course, the standard add/drop and withdrawal deadlines do not apply. Add/drop is the second lecture day and withdrawal is the fourth lecture day.

subject: EDEE
title: Elementary School Mathematics 1
description: Elementary Education: The first of two courses specially designed for elementary school pre-service teachers. Focused on key areas of what teachers need to know and be able to do to support students' development of mathematical understanding (focus on mathematics content, students' reasoning, and pedagogy). Provides insight and understanding of the Quebec elementary mathematics program.

subject: EDEE
title: Mathématique au primaire 1
description: Les éléments essentiels à connaître et maîtriser afin de soutenir le développement de la compréhension mathématique des élèves (contenus mathématiques, raisonnement des élèves et approches pédagogiques).
notes: Permet d’approfondir la compréhension du Programme de formation de l’école québécoise en mathématique au primaire.

subject: EDEE
title: Use and Adaptation of Curricula
description: Provincial or Nunavut curricula as a basis for planning, materials production and evaluation. Methods of adapting curricula to local needs and of developing local courses of study in First Nations and Inuit community schools.

subject: EDEE
title: Reading Methods for First Nations/Inuit Languages
description: Overview of reading theories and their application to First Nations and Inuit languages; processes used by proficient readers. Methods of teaching reading.

prerequisites.text: Fluency in the Indigenous language of study.

subject: EDEE
title: Orientation to Education
description: Introduction to planning and maintaining a learning environment in Indigenous classroom as a unique pedagogical setting. Study and application of differential learning styles.

subject: EDEE
title: Reading and Writing in First Nations and Inuit Languages
description: Methods of teaching reading and writing in syllabics and other First Nations and Inuit writing systems. The principles of sight word reading instruction, child observation, material development and guided instruction.

prerequisites.text: Fluency in the First Nations and Inuit language of study.

notes: These courses are only for the Office of First Nations and Inuit Education (OFNIE) for getting people to register online.
The drop deadlines vary according to OFNIE program cohort scheduling.

subject: EDEE
title: Kindergarten Classroom Pedagogy
description: Elementary Education : An orientation to the Kindergarten curriculum. Integration of the school subject areas (language arts, second language, mathematics, social sciences, science, expressive arts, moral and religious education, and physical education) in a manner appropriate to the developmental level of the pre-school child.

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have taken EDEC 310 and EDEE 250.

subject: EDEE
title: Pédagogie en maternelle
description: Initiation au programme de la maternelle en contexte d’immersion française. Intégration des différentes disciplines scolaires - français langue d’enseignement; français langue seconde; mathématique; univers social; science et technologie; arts plastiques; art dramatique; musique; culture et citoyenneté québécoise; et éducation physique et à la santé - de manière adaptée au développement global de l’enfant à la maternelle.

subject: EDEE
title: Reading Methods - Kindergarten/Elementary
description: Methods and materials for the teaching of reading.
notes: **These courses are only for the Office of First Nations and Inuit Education (OFNIE) for getting people to register online.

subject: EDEE
title: Elementary School Science
description: Science as a means of exploring and explaining our environment. A study of some of the fundamental concepts and process skills common to most elementary programs.
notes: The course includes a fee of $15 for required lab supplies, including take-home experimental kits

subject: EDEE
title: Science au primaire 1
description: La science comme moyen d’explorer et d’expliquer notre environnement en contexte d’immersion française au primaire. Étude de certains concepts fondamentaux et des démarches d’investigation scientifique communes à la plupart des programmes de science au primaire.
notes: S'appuie principalement sur le Programme de formation de l'école québécoise.
Le cours comprend des frais de 15 $ pour le matériel de laboratoire obligatoire, y compris des trousses expérimentales à emporter à la maison.

subject: EDEE
title: Elementary School Science 2
description: Elementary Education : A study of science programs and teaching strategies appropriate for providing elementary school children with an appreciation of the nature and method of science inquiry.

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have taken EDEE 275.

notes: The course includes a fee of $20.60 for required lab supplies, including take-home experimental kits.

subject: EDEE
title: Science au primaire 2
description: Étude des programmes de science et des stratégies d’enseignement appropriées afin de permettre aux élèves du primaire, en contexte d’immersion française, de développer une compréhension et une appréciation de la nature des sciences et des démarches d’investigation scientifique.
notes: S'appuie principalement sur le Programme de formation de l'école québécoise.
Le cours comprend des frais de 20,60 $ pour le matériel de laboratoire obligatoire, notamment des trousses expérimentales à emporter à la maison.

subject: EDEE
title: Geography, History and Citizenship Education
description: Designed for elementary school teachers. A multi-disciplinary and cross-curricular investigation of various citizenship education themes, geographical regions and historical periods as outlined in the Quebec Education Program.
notes: **Due to the intensive nature of this course, the standard add/drop and withdrawal deadlines do not apply. Add/drop is the third lecture day and withdrawal is the sixth lecture day.

subject: EDEE
title: Social Studies Pedagogy
description: Elementary Education : Programs, materials and strategies for social studies from Kindergarten through grade six.

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have taken EDEE 282.

subject: EDEE
title: L'univers social au primaire
description: Étude des programmes, des ressources et des stratégies pédagogiques en univers social, dans des classes de maternelle et de primaire en contexte d’immersion française.
notes: S'appuie principalement sur le Programme de formation de l'école québécoise.

subject: EDEE
title: Using Instructional Resources
description: Students will learn to find, assess, and use a variety of instructional resources. Specifically, they will learn how to evaluate the instructional value of software packages and other established audio-visual materials; how to make and use simple audio-visual materials; and how to find additional resource material in the library.

subject: EDEE
title: Children's Literature
description: Selection and use of literature suitable for children in the elementary school.

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have taken ENGL 240, ENGL 341

notes: Limited enrolment

subject: EDEE
title: Teaching Elementary Mathematics 2
description: Elementary Education: The second of two courses specifically designed for elementary school pre-service teachers. Provides opportunities for the development of increasingly sophisticated knowledge and practices specific to elementary mathematics teaching. Provides insight and understanding of the Quebec modern elementary mathematics program.

subject: EDEE
title: Mathématique au primaire 2
description: Deuxième de deux cours conçus spécialement pour les futures personnes enseignantes du primaire en contexte d’immersion française. Développement des connaissances et des pratiques de plus en plus approfondies propres à l’enseignement de la mathématique au primaire.
notes: Permet d’approfondir la compréhension du Programme de formation de l’école québécoise en mathématique au primaire.

subject: EDEE
title: Grammar and Composition 1
description: Reading and writing of an Indigenous language which includes using a computer. Focus is on nouns, verbs, prefixes, suffixes, along with specific Indigenous lexicon.

subject: EDEE
title: Grammar and Composition 2
description: Reading and writing of an Indigenous language. Intermediate and advanced aspects of grammar of the Indigenous language. Continuation of language development.

subject: EDEE
title: Integrating the Curriculum
description: Strategies and methods for integrating the individual subject areas in the elementary school curriculum, using the Québec curriculum as the primary example.

subject: EDEE
title: Classroom Practices
description: Theory-based strategies for setting up, managing and teaching in the elementary school classroom.

corequisites.text: EDEE 350, EDEE 355 and EDFE 303 or EDFE 306

subject: EDEE
title: Third Year Professional Seminar (Kindergarten/Elementary)
description: Theory-based strategies for setting up, managing and teaching in the elementary school classroom. Methods for integrating the individual subject areas in the elementary school curriculum, using the Quebec curriculum as the primary example. Professional portfolios and professional competencies will be addressed.

restrictions.text: B.Ed (K/Elem) students. Not open to students who have taken EDEE 350 or EDEE 352.

subject: EDEE
title: Classroom-based Evaluation
description: The role of evaluation within kindergarten/elementary school programs. Topics include the kinds of information needed, different techniques for collecting that information, and ways of interpreting it to make educational decisions. Principles and a variety of methods for evaluation are discussed and practiced.
notes: **Due to the intensive nature of this course, the standard add/drop and withdrawal deadlines do not apply. Add/drop is the second lecture day and withdrawal is the fourth lecture day.
**This course is only for the Office of First Nations and Inuit Education (OFNIE) for getting people to register online.
**Web drop deadline is May 22, 2025
**Web add deadline is June 4, 2025
**Web withdrawal deadline is June 5, 2025

subject: EDEE
title: Évaluation en français langue seconde
description: Rôle de l’évaluation dans les programmes d’éducation maternelle et primaire en français langue seconde. Exploration des informations nécessaires à une évaluation efficace, des diverses méthodes de collecte de données et des modalités d’interprétation permettant d’éclairer la prise de décision pédagogique. Une attention particulière est accordée aux pratiques d’évaluation en immersion française ainsi qu'aux approches critiques en évaluation.

subject: EDEE
title: Traditional Indigenous Life Skills
description: Sharing, modelling and transferring of Indigenous knowledge about living in harmony with the elements and the environment. Featured topics include weather and its traditional interpretation, ice conditions, animal behaviours and their interactions with the environment. Hands-on learning will be emphasized.

restrictions.text: This course is offered only to students registered in First Nations and Inuit Education programs.

notes: **These courses are only for the Office of First Nations and Inuit Education (OFNIE) for getting people to register online.
**Web drop deadline is May 23, 2024
**Web add deadline is June 5, 2024
**Web withdrawal deadline is June 6, 2024

subject: EDEE
title: Integrating Indigenous Storytelling and Creative Writing
description: Students will be involved in storytelling and practical writing activities. Stories will be gathered from elders, residential school survivors and/or from their own experience. The intent of this course is to broaden knowledge and skill in the reading and writing of the students' heritage language.

restrictions.text: This course is offered only to students registered in First Nations and Inuit Education programs.

subject: EDEE
title: Traditional Healing
description: Indigenous traditional healing and its cultural value. The origins of Indigenous traditional medicines will be explored through elders' knowledge and stories.

subject: EDEE
title: Oral and Family History
description: Oral and family history techniques, emphasising kinship terms and the importance of kinship values to Indigenous Cultures.

subject: EDEE
title: First Nations and Inuit Curriculum
description: An introduction to First Nations and Inuit curriculum: how curriculum needs in Aboriginal communities are similar to and different from mainstream ones, the range of ways in which First Nations and Inuit have responded to curriculum needs based on language, culture, and community perceptions.

subject: EDEE
title: Ecological Studies
description: A lecture, laboratory and field course to train elementary school teachers in the principles and practices of field biology and nature tours. The observation and identification of various organisms and a study of their ecological relationships in the web of life.
notes: Offered through Summer Studies
